brief.headline: Priority alert: possible sweethearting at the till on the staffed till camera.
observed: At 5.6 s: Bagging count rose to 3 with no scan in the two seconds before.
At 7.0 s: Bagging count rose to 4 with no scan in the two seconds before.
Bagged but not scanned was 1; the typical value for normal clips on this camera is -1 (range -3 to 0).
Left the basket but not scanned was 2; the typical value for normal clips on this camera is 0 (range -2 to 1).
benign_explanations: Bulky items were scanned in the trolley with a handset.
The quantity key was used for identical items.
The item counter miscounted items that were stacked.
brief.recommended_action: Refer to the store manager and people team with the clip, the receipt and the till log. Follow the internal investigation procedure.
brief.confidence_note: Model risk is 1.00, which is strong evidence for this scenario. Pose tracking was clear throughout the clip.
